title: 若駒Sの後に・『まぐれ』から

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature is ecstatic that she was able to surpass Tokai Teio in the Wakagoma Stakes and lets out a shout of joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, seeing Tokai Teio's positive attitude even in defeat instantly dampens her mood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She concludes that she was only able to win because of luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest a trip to enter a local race, the Kokura Kinen, to give her more confidence.
